Something I've wanted for decades is the ability to present a low quality recording of video game gameplay and have an AI reverse engineer the game's state so that you could play it back in an emulator like a player piano playing sheet music.
I know, I know; you'll tell me that RNG is difficult to reverse engineer, but I'll just reply that if speedrunners and TAS guys can manipulate game state in predictable ways, then I'm sure an AI who can iterate thousands of times on gameppay could figure out how to recreate a particular sequence of events in a game.
